name: The Iron Charter
opening: The Iron Charter guild hall smells of polish and old maps. The guildmaster taps a notice on the quest board: DANGEROUS, NO NEWCOMERS. Then she looks you up and down, and smiles.
picture: a grand stone guild hall with red banners, a quest board covered in notices, torches glowing
beats: Beat a rival adventuring party to the dangerous quest
Complete the quest no newcomer is allowed to take
secret: The dangerous quest was posted by the guildmaster's missing brother, as a cry for help.
